nodes.label: Closure Table — Hierarchical Category Queries (t_d_article_hierarchy)
nodes.contributor: rationale: Chosen for O(1) hierarchical queries on article categories; supports max 10 depth levels. Trigger maintains ancestor/descendant/depth records. Prevents circular references and enforces max depth.

nodes.label: Window Exports Pattern — Public Functions via adapters/windowExports.ts
nodes.contributor: rationale: Avoids inline JS in HTML templates; all onclick-callable functions are exported via window.xxx in adapters/windowExports.ts. Enables TypeScript type safety and testability.

nodes.label: VERSION File — Single Source of Truth for Versioning
nodes.contributor: rationale: Pre-commit hook syncs package.json/package-lock.json with VERSION; CI/CD builds Docker images and updates IMAGE_VERSIONS.json on push. Semver major.minor.patch incremented by patch step per release.

nodes.label: Git Branch Policy — dev/* → test → prod Pipeline
nodes.contributor: rationale: PRs go dev/* → test only; prod branch contains only release-ready code. Branching from prod bypasses test-stage validation.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend Service — API + Web Pages
Deploy Workflow — install.sh → setup.sh → deploy.sh
nodes.contributor: rationale: Three distinct roles: install.sh installs Docker/system deps (once); setup.sh syncs repo to /opt/budget + generates .env; deploy.sh starts/updates containers and runs migrations. Never run setup.sh from /opt/budget itself.

nodes.label: Offline-First Architecture — Dexie.js IndexedDB + WebSocket Sync
nodes.contributor: rationale: Transactions stored locally via Dexie (IndexedDB) first; sync with server via WebSocket when online. Write-behind pattern for instant UX. Content hash deduplication prevents duplicate creates on re-sync.

hyperedges.label: Deploy Pipeline Triad — VERSION + CI/CD + deploy.sh
hyperedges.rationale: VERSION file triggers CI/CD which builds Docker images stored in registry; deploy.sh on server pulls those images. Together they form the complete release pipeline.

hyperedges.label: Offline Sync Triad — Dexie + WSClient + SyncAPI
hyperedges.rationale: These three components collectively implement the offline sync protocol: Dexie stores facts locally, WSClient transmits sync messages, SyncAPI processes them server-side. All three must be consistent for sync to work.

hyperedges.label: Database Pattern Triad — SCD Type 2 + Closure Table + Alembic
hyperedges.rationale: The three advanced DB patterns applied together: SCD Type 2 for dimension versioning, Closure Table for hierarchy, Alembic for managing their schema evolution. All are defined in the baseline migration 20251109_001.
